text:
asha: Quick heads up — we saw a spike of unassigned leads in HubSpot around 03:12 UTC. ~42 leads hit 'Unassigned' instead of going to SDR round-robin. Looks correlated with enrichment timeouts.

jamal: Uh oh. Which workflow and which enrichment job?

asha: inbound-routing-v2 + hs-enrich-async. Enrichment occasionally takes ~12s; our webhook to routing-service times out at 10s so HS marks as failed -> Unassigned.

rina: We can increase HS webhook timeout but that's a bandaid. Two-phase suggestion: short-term timeout bump, medium-term change routing to make claim resilient, long-term make enrichment async observability better.

kyle: I can add claim-retry with exponential backoff in routing-service. Also propose a lightweight heartbeat flag so HS treats lead as "claim-pending" instead of final Unassigned while retries happen.

asha: Patch idea snippet (for HS config):
```
workflow: inbound-routing-v2
webhook.timeout_ms=15000
enrich.ttl_sec=30
```
This buys time and reduces false unassigned.

rina: Also update SF fallback mapping: currently fallback owner becomes NULL/unassigned which breaks downstream workflows. Change fallback to sales.queue.default (keeps ownership metadata and easier to reconcile).

jamal: Timelines? kyle can canary the retry + heartbeat in routing-canary this week. If smoke looks good we roll to prod next Tue. SLA target for this flow: 99% owners assigned within 20s.

hs-sync-bot: routing-service-canary deploy started -> routing-canary-1.12.3 (sha: d4f2b7) :rocket:

asha: I'll schedule a 2hr smoke tomorrow 09:00-11:00 PST against HubSpot sandbox and add a dashboard tile: "assign latency (hs -> sf)" + alert if >5% >20s.

rina: I'll prepare the SF mapping change and a backfill plan for leads that were marked Unassigned in the last 24h.

kyle: I'll open PR for claim-retry + heartbeat probe, include config flags: retry.max=4, backoff.ms=500, heartbeat.ttl=25s. Will link to PR here when ready.

asha: Action items recap: kyle = PR for retry/heartbeat, rina = SF fallback mapping + backfill plan, jamal = smoke scheduling & monitoring plan, asha = HS sandbox + dashboard/alert. Re-check after smoke. :thumbsup:

jamal: Sounds good. Ping me when the canary metrics start flowing (assign_rate, assign_latency, fallback_rate).

asha: Will do. Thanks team.
